job.title: Business Development Manager - Digital Marketing Agency
job.description:
If you’re a hungry, strategic BDM who loves the chase and knows how to sell digital, this is your next move. Join a fast‑growing agency with a strong delivery engine behind you, real earning potential, and the autonomy to build a high‑performing pipeline.

About the Role You’ll drive new business across SMB and mid‑market clients, selling a suite of digital marketing solutions that deliver real commercial impact. This role is built for someone who thrives in outbound environments, runs a sharp sales process, and closes with confidence.

You will:
  • Drive new business through outbound prospecting, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, email outreach, and targeted campaigns
  • Sell digital services including SEO, Paid Media, Analytics, Web Design, Social & Content, and Email Marketing/Automation
  • Own the full sales cycle: discovery, scoping, proposals, presentations, negotiation, and close
  • Identify upsell and cross‑sell opportunities
  • Attend industry events, networking functions, and meetups to build your pipeline
  • Work closely with internal delivery teams to ensure seamless onboarding and client satisfaction
  • Maintain disciplined CRM hygiene and accurate forecasting
What You Bring
  • Experience selling digital marketing services (agency or SaaS/MarTech experience highly regarded)
  • Technical understanding of at least one digital discipline: SEO, Paid Media, Analytics, Web Design, Social, Content, Email/Automation
  • Proven success in outbound sales and building your own pipeline
  • Strong experience with LinkedIn Sales Navigator or similar prospecting tools
  • Confident communicator able to run strategic conversations with business owners and marketing leaders
  • Self‑sufficient, proactive, and motivated by targets and uncapped earning potential
  • Ability to manage multiple deals, priorities, and follow‑ups with discipline
  • Genuine commercial curiosity and interest in digital marketing trends
Why This Role?
  • $100–$130k base + uncapped commission (realistic OTE $180k+)
  • High‑performing, supportive team with strong marketing and delivery capability
  • Autonomy to build your own pipeline
  • Access to warm inbound leads to complement your outbound activity
  • Clear progression pathways as the agency scales – potential step into Sales Leadership
  • Modern office environment, flexible working options, and a culture that celebrates wins
  • Opportunities to represent the brand at events, conferences, and industry meetups
If you’re driven, commercially sharp, and ready to earn big while selling high‑impact digital solutions, we want to hear from you.

job.title: SEO Lead
job.description:
An exciting opportunity is available for an experienced SEO Lead to lead a growing digital Experience capability in Brisbane.

This is a leadership role responsible for client delivery across SEO, generative search optimisation, analytics and reporting, while helping establish the SEO function as a centre of excellence.

You’ll lead specialist teams, strengthen client relationships and drive commercial, operational and product development across the function.

What You’ll Be Doing
  • Lead SEO strategy and delivery across key client portfolios.
  • Oversee SEO, generative search, analytics and reporting services.
  • Manage and develop Associate Directors, Managers and specialist talent.
  • Lead resourcing, utilisation and capability planning across client teams.
  • Build trusted relationships with senior clients and stakeholders.
  • Track revenue, profitability, scopes, invoicing and commercial performance. Identify opportunities to grow existing client relationships.
  • Drive innovation, quality control and continuous improvement.
  • Build relationships with technology and platform partners to keep the team ahead of emerging trends.
What We’re Looking For
This opportunity requires an experienced digital leader with the credibility to operate across senior clients, commercial strategy, people leadership and technical Experience disciplines.

We’re particularly interested in candidates with:
  • Deep experience across SEO, search strategy and digital performance.
  • Strong understanding of generative/AI search and changing search behaviour.
  • Experience leading senior client relationships and complex portfolios with proven management of Managers, Associate Directors or senior specialists. A leadership style focused on coaching, collaboration and high performance.
  • Experience identifying and converting client growth opportunities.
  • A track record of improving processes, products and delivery standards.
  • Strong analytics, reporting and measurement capability.
  • Experience collaborating across strategy, media, technology and performance teams.
This is an opportunity for a senior digital leader to have genuine influence over people, product, clients and the future direction of the business.

Apply now or send your CV to brett@s2m.com.au or contact us at 02 8396 6800 for a confidential discussion.

job.title: Account Manager
job.description:
We are seeking a friendly and professional Account Manager who excels in creating a welcoming environment for clients.

The ideal candidate will possess strong organisational and administrative skills, with a keen eye for detail and a proactive approach to their work.

Key Responsibilities:
Client Interaction: Engage with clients in a genuine, approachable manner, ensuring they feel valued and understood.

Professional Communication: Maintain a professional demeanour in both written and verbal communications.

Organization and Proactivity: Manage tasks efficiently, with a focus on detail and proactive problem-solving.

Administrative Support: Provide robust administrative support, ensuring seamless operations.

Customer Service and Transition to Account Management: Leverage at least 3 years of experience in a customer service or event coordination role to transition into account management, bringing valuable insights and skills.

Creative Problem-Solving: Demonstrate the ability to develop and implement creative solutions to overcome challenges.

Project Management: Coordinate and manage projects, ensuring that all stakeholders are aligned and that goals are met.

Communication Skills: Exhibit strong communication abilities, capable of conveying ideas clearly and working collaboratively with team members and clients.
